summary: Frontend E2E of Vampire's Choice (Vite+React 19+TS, client-only). Verified PRIORITY 1 core loop, choice/currency/toast, PRIORITY 1 CRITICAL book-1 ending → return to Landing (no loop), PRIORITY 2 state screens + persistence, PRIORITY 3 settings reset. All items pass. No backend to test.

issues: Achievement 'Unlocked' banner is a fixed overlay near top of viewport. In a Playwright coordinate-based click (with force=True) it can intercept hits on choice buttons scrolled into that region, causing the click to hit an overlapping element (e.g., bottom nav). Not reproducible via a normal DOM .click(). Recommend adding pointer-events: none to the banner backdrop (only its close button clickable) OR z-index/position tuning so it never overlaps choice buttons for tap gestures on small viewports.
The consequence toast (bottom-center) similarly floats over content — consider verifying it does not overlap tappable nav on small screens.

priority_results.P1_core_loop: PASS - Landing→Character creation (Seraphina, Woman, Bisexual)→Awaken lands on 'Midnight at the Gates' Ch1. 'First Choice' achievement banner shows after first choice.
priority_results.P1_choice_currency_toast: PASS - c1_pursue_shadow then c2a_stand_ground: Blood Coins 250 → 265 (+15) confirmed. Consequence toast 'Lucian is deeply intrigued...' shows. Lucian affinity increments correctly (50→56→...).
priority_results.P1_book_ending_returns_to_landing: PASS (CRITICAL FIX VERIFIED) - Full Lucian playthrough (11 choices) reaches 'The Dawning Eclipse'. Clicking c3_3_conclude_book1 shows 'Book I: Bloodlines of Blackthorn Complete! (+100 …)' toast AND app returns to Landing. Landing shows Continue Story button (Begin is hidden by design when a save exists). No loop back to Chapter 1. Clicking #landing-continue-btn resumes exactly on 'The Dawning Eclipse' scene (Chapter 3) — not Chapter 1.
priority_results.P2_state_screens: PASS - Bonds shows Lord Lucian Cross with 100/100 affinity = Devoted. Trophies shows First Choice, First Blood, Dangerous Liaison, Secret Keeper, Shadow Sovereign (plus The Story Begins) → 6/6 unlocked. Character screen shows Seraphina, 570 Blood Coins, Scenes Traversed: 11 (>1), Active Chapter: 3.
priority_results.P2_persistence: PASS - After full reload, Landing shows Continue Story; clicking resumes on 'The Dawning Eclipse' with 570 coins intact. LocalStorage key vampires_choice_player_state_v1 persists state.
priority_results.P3_settings_reset: PASS - #nav-settings-btn → #reset-all-data-btn opens 'Reset All Story Data?' modal → #confirm-modal-reset-btn clears state (player:null, achievements reset) and returns to fresh Landing showing 'BEGIN YOUR STORY'.

action_items: (Optional/Minor) Ensure the achievement-unlocked banner overlay does not intercept pointer events over choice buttons — either add pointer-events:none on its wrapper (leaving close button clickable) or move it to a region that never covers the reading choices area on mobile viewports.
(Minor UX) Landing hides Begin when a save exists; confirm this is intentional. Task text mentioned 'Begin/Continue visible' — currently only Continue is shown post-completion. Not a blocker.
critical_code_review_comments: Engine split (engine/effects/navigation/conditions) is clean and pure; makeChoice in gameState.ts correctly delegates and handles returnToLanding + emits UI events.
book1.ts is 722 lines; consider splitting per-chapter scene modules for maintainability (>700-line file guideline).

ReadingScreen fallback ('Return to Blackthorn Gates') dispatches a hardcoded fallback choice — consider making it a proper 'return to landing' action via gameStateManager rather than a fake choice object.
Achievement banner is a floating fixed overlay — add pointer-events guards or auto-dismiss timer to reduce interaction friction on mobile.
seed_data_creation: None; fresh state via localStorage.clear() before runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use JavaScript .click() (via page.evaluate) OR dismiss the achievement banner first, before hitting choice buttons. Playwright's page.click(..., force=True) uses coordinate-based dispatch and can be intercepted by the fixed achievement banner overlay, giving false negatives (looked like scene did not advance / coins did not update). All PRIORITY 1/2/3 pass under normal DOM click semantics.
